import re
DEN = re.compile(r"AccessDenied|UnauthorizedOperation$")
REGION="eu-central-1"
START=datetime.datetime(2026,11,10,6,0,0,tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
END=datetime.datetime(2026,11,11,9,20,0,tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
t0=time.time()
token=None; total=0; pages=0; den=[]; tag_ok=[]
while True:
    p={"StartTime":START,"EndTime":END,"MaxResults":50}
    if token: p["NextToken"]=token
    r=await call_boto3(service_name="cloudtrail",operation_name="LookupEvents",region_name=REGION,params=p)
    pages+=1
    for e in r.get("Events",[]):
        total+=1
        ev=json.loads(e["CloudTrailEvent"])
        c=ev.get("errorCode")
        ui=ev.get("userIdentity") or {}
        if isinstance(c,str) and DEN.search(c):
            den.append({"t":ev.get("eventTime"),"src":ev.get("eventSource"),"name":ev.get("eventName"),"code":c,
              "msg":ev.get("errorMessage"),"arn":ui.get("arn"),"region":ev.get("awsRegion"),
              "bucket":(ev.get("requestParameters") or {}).get("bucketName") or (ev.get("requestParameters") or {}).get("resourceArn"),
              "ua":ev.get("userAgent"),"src_id":(ui.get("sessionContext") or {}).get("sourceIdentity")})
        elif ev.get("eventName")=="GetBucketTagging" and not c:
            tag_ok.append([ev.get("eventTime"),ui.get("arn"),(ev.get("requestParameters") or {}).get("bucketName")])
    token=r.get("NextToken")
    if not token or time.time()-t0>45: break
result={"total":total,"pages":pages,"done":token is None,"token":token,"den":den,"tag_ok":tag_ok,"secs":round(time.time()-t0,1)}
result
